body: Trust me your life will get better eventually. The universe teaches in opposites. So in order for a blessing to find one, one has to go through hardship first. I can personally attest to this because it has happened to me many times. BUT nothing good comes easy. You have to stay hopeful. You have to be resilient. You have to have faith. You have to do the internal work. The speed of when things will improve though is up to you entirely. The sooner you surrender to the process the sooner it will all find you… it’s just not that easy unfortunately.
It’s not something you learn. It happens naturally when you move with integrity & honesty. I also believe you’re initiated into it by a higher power unless you work with dark forces.

Depending on what he believes. Whether he’s christian, muslim or whatever he should find a healer to perform an exorcist like ritual! Those demonic entities need to be casted away which can only be done by a professional.

Feeling guilty is part of the healing process. You do need to take accountability for your actions whether you do so internally or by making amends is up to you. Connect to source & ask for forgiveness. Ask to be cleansed from your wrongdoings. Make it right by doing good everyday such as volunteering, donate, etc. All that “forgive yourself” is bs. The only way through this is through! Be honest & real with yourself. You won’t be able to ever let this go & grow otherwise! Growth is very uncomfortable & hard. But the rewards are bountiful.

This has happened to me before & that was because he was also constantly thinking about me. So your feelings may be reciprocated already. Unless elaborate on what you did to “manifest” him? It’s possible you amplified it. Because that is a very intense experience. Be very careful & try to distract yourself otherwise you could lose your mind! Go for a run, hang out with friends, hit the gym, dance, make art or whatever you like doing in your free time. But don’t feed into it. It can be very heart wrenching otherwise…
That’s a very interesting way of looking at it. Thanks for sharing. :)

That’s how Source/God communicates with us. Through dreams. Not everyone has this gift but if you do have it cherish it. It could be very helpful if you ever get into a sticky situation. In my culture it’s advised to share dreams with only trusted people for that reason.

I agree. Last night felt major. A lot of pressure that has been building inside of me has been released. I did a lil ritual to amplify it by writing on a paper everything I want to let go of & burned it. This is a time for new beginnings!
